thread:
Olga (partnerships): Cumulus Edge preview confirmed for next week (Mon launch). Need NDA signed, customs cleared, and a concise go/no-go checklist. Can we split owners? @Ben for logistics, @Kira for HW, @Tess for bench, @Marta for legal.
Ben (partner-ops): Ill take shipping + customs. Partner provided HS codes and a copy of the commercial invoice. ETA Tue afternoon. Will need rack U and max current to confirm PDUs.
Kira (hw-eng): Hardware note: units are 2x1U nodes, expect 1.6kW steady per rack. Firmware tags: cumulus-0.9 (stable) and cumulus-1.0rc (perf patch). Recommend we test both. Need serials and boot logs from partner.
Tess (bench): I will own the bench validation. Proposed minimal matrix: 4096 single-stream latency, batch8 throughput, and a 6h soak. Also a quick quality eval on 500 prompts vs redwood/v1.2. Acceptance: p99 within 12% and quality delta <1%.
Marta (legal): Ive reviewed their NDA. Requested two redlines: telemetry scope (no raw customer payload retention) and embargo window (30 days). Sent redlined doc to partner counsel.
Olga (partnerships): Also need a short partner feedback template for day-zero: summary table, perf numbers, infra notes, regression flag, owner action items. Who can draft?
Tess (bench): Ill draft the feedback template. Will include a one-line go/no-go, perf summary table, and links to perf traces. Sample run command for infra: 
```bash
./bench --model redwood/v1.2 --seq 4096 --batch 1 --out /tmp/cumulus/metrics.json
```
We will export metrics to s3://redwood-preview/cumulus/.
Kira (hw-eng): Heads-up: PCIe lane mapping differs on these boards; if we see degraded throughput, capture lspci and dmesg and vendor kernel module versions.
Ben (partner-ops): Shipping labels created, customs docs uploaded to drive. Carrier ETA Tue 18:30. Rack slot reserved Wed.
CommsBot: Calendar created: "Cumulus Edge - Preview Week" Mon-Fri. Invitees: Olga, Ben, Kira, Tess, Marta.
Olga (partnerships): Marketing asked to wait for bench + legal sign-off before any joint comms. We'll treat partner as embargoed.
Tess (bench): Potential blocker: quant path in cumulus-1.0rc seems to reorder kernels, may affect token timing. I'll add a micro-benchmark to isolate that.
Kira (hw-eng): If kernel reordering shows up, we can attempt vendor stable image or request a patch. Will log firmware+kernel versions in the feedback doc.
Marta (legal): NDA countersigned by partner? Theyre reviewing, asked for clarification on telemetry retention period.
Olga (partnerships): OK action list: Marta - try to get signed NDA by Tue EOD; Ben - confirm ETA + rack by Wed; Kira - firmware/kernel capture + PCIe checks by Thu; Tess - bench runner + feedback draft by Mon AM. I'll run day-zero sync Mon 09:30.
Ben (partner-ops): Will post tracking and rack slot when confirmed.
Tess (bench): Uploading bench runner and draft template to the shared drive now. Link will be posted.
Olga (partnerships): Thanks all. Keeping thread for coordination. :rocket:
